mandate: Owner report 2026-10-16 on the installed 0.2.x app (possibly GHES): the right side of a diff did not syntax highlight until the reviewer switched off and back to the file. Find the race, fix the root cause so both sides always end highlighted, test with a negative control, run the full dev ctest once, reseal, and merge.
root_cause: adopt_classification handed a classification publication to the first side whose blob matched. When both sides are one blob (pure rename or move, or a file two compared updates share) classify_comparison asks twice, the host coalesces the second request, and the one publication coloured only the left pane; when it answered after the diff was shown the display-time cache read had nothing to give, so the right pane stayed plain until the file was opened again. Latent since ae6da0b54 (BPR-0185, 2026-08-07); not a recent regression.
fix: adopt_classification adopts the spans on every side whose blob they name. Hardening: clear_diff_selection retires the appearance host's in-flight classifications (new appearance_application_host::cancel_classifications) beside the blob bindings and reads it already stops, so a later request for the same blob is submitted afresh rather than coalesced onto a stopped read.
